pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #4 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many main tones does Mandarin have, not counting the neutral tone? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. Six
   C. Four
   D. Three

2. What is pinyin? (1 mark)
   A. A system that writes Mandarin sounds with letters
   B. A kind of Chinese food
   C. A Chinese number
   D. A type of pen

3. Which Chinese word means "younger brother"? (1 mark)
   A. 弟弟 dìdi
   B. 妈妈 māma
   C. 哥哥 gēge
   D. 有 yǒu

4. Fill the blank: 这是____妈妈。 (This is my mum.) (1 mark)
   A. 我
   B. 谁
   C. 什么
   D. 你

5. Fill the blank: 冰箱____厨房。 (The fridge is in the kitchen.) (1 mark)
   A. 上
   B. 是
   C. 有
   D. 在

6. Fill the blank: 电视在桌子____。 (The television is on the table.) (1 mark)
   A. 在
   B. 下
   C. 里
   D. 上

7. Which sentence means "On Friday, go to the mosque."? (1 mark)
   A. 我星期三去学校。
   B. 星期五,去清真寺。
   C. 明天是星期四。
   D. 星期天,去教堂。

8. What does 三 (sān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. One
   B. Three
   C. Six
   D. Seven

9. Fill the blank: 祝你生日____! (Happy birthday!) (1 mark)
   A. 礼物
   B. 朋友
   C. 快乐
   D. 蛋糕

10. Which is a good active listening habit? (1 mark)
   A. Think about lunch
   B. Talk to your friend
   C. Face the speaker and listen for key words
   D. Look at the wall

11. Which is a good step for reading a sentence at a good pace? (1 mark)
   A. Read as fast as you can at once
   B. Read without looking
   C. Read only the first word
   D. Read slowly first, then join the words and speed up

12. What do the three words 早饭, 午饭 and 晚饭 have in common? (1 mark)
   A. They are days
   B. They are fruits
   C. They are drinks
   D. They are names of meals

13. Which sentence means "I use my eyes to see."? (1 mark)
   A. 我用嘴巴说。
   B. 我用眼睛看。
   C. 我用耳朵听。
   D. 我有两只眼睛。

14. What does 膝盖 (xīgài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hand
   B. To brush teeth
   C. To cry
   D. Knee

15. Which word means "very" in 雨很大? (1 mark)
   A. 的
   B. 雨
   C. 很
   D. 大

16. Fill the blank: 太阳____大。 (The sun is very big.) (1 mark)
   A. 在
   B. 有
   C. 是
   D. 很

17. What does 沙发在门旁边 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sofa is under the door
   B. The sofa is beside the door
   C. The door is in the sofa
   D. The sofa is in the garden

18. Fill the blank: 沙发在门____。 (The sofa is beside the door.) (1 mark)
   A. 里
   B. 旁边
   C. 上面
   D. 下面

19. Fill the blank: ____好! (Hello, teacher!) (1 mark)
   A. 朋友
   B. 爸爸
   C. 同学
   D. 老师

20. Read the pinyin: zàijiàn! What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good morning!
   B. My name is Xiaoming.
   C. Goodbye!
   D. Hello, teacher!

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Put these words in order and translate: 在 / 电视 / 上 / 桌子. (3 marks)

22. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my older brother." (2 marks)

23. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday." and "On Wednesday I go to school." (4 marks)

24. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." and "The bathroom is beside the garden." (4 marks)

25. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 盘子, 爱 and 唱歌. (3 marks)

26. Write the numbers 1 to 5 in Chinese characters. (2 marks)

27. How do you write ü after j, q and x? Give one example. (2 marks)

28. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 旁边 and 您好. (2 marks)

29. Write three actions of the body and the part that does each. (3 marks)

30. Blend the syllables zhuō and zi and give the meaning. (2 marks)

31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My birthday is on 5 March." (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #4 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Four
   Mandarin has four main tones: high level, rising, dipping and falling.

2. A — A system that writes Mandarin sounds with letters
   Pinyin uses the same letters as English and Kiswahili to show how Mandarin sounds.

3. A — 弟弟 dìdi
   弟弟 (dìdi) means younger brother.

4. A — 我
   我 means my.

5. D — 在
   在 means is at or is in.

6. D — 上
   上 means on.

7. B — 星期五,去清真寺。
   星期五,去清真寺。 (xīngqīwǔ, qù qīngzhēnsì.) means "On Friday, go to the mosque.".

8. B — Three
   三 (sān) means three.

9. C — 快乐
   生日快乐 is happy birthday.

10. C — Face the speaker and listen for key words
   Active listeners give the speaker attention and catch the key words.

11. D — Read slowly first, then join the words and speed up
   Slow reading first, then a natural speed.

12. D — They are names of meals
   饭 is meal, and the first characters tell the time of day.

13. B — 我用眼睛看。
   我用眼睛看。 (wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn.) means "I use my eyes to see.".

14. D — Knee
   膝盖 (xīgài) means knee.

15. C — 很
   很 hěn means very.

16. D — 很
   很 means very and goes before 大.

17. B — The sofa is beside the door
   旁边 is beside.

18. B — 旁边
   旁边 is beside.

19. D — 老师
   老师 is teacher.

20. C — Goodbye!
   zàijiàn! is 再见!, which means "Goodbye!".

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: 电视在桌子上。 The television is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。and pinyin optional, 1 mark for the meaning.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: 那是我哥哥。 nà shì wǒ gēge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān. 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 浴室在花园旁边。 yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: 盘子: pánzi, plate. 爱: ài, love. 唱歌: chànggē, to sing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: 一, 二, 三, 四, 五.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for all five correct, 1 mark for three or four.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is written as u, for example qù (to go).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the example.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: 旁边: pángbiān, beside. 您好: nín hǎo, hello (polite).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 看 with the eyes, 听 with the ears, 说 with the mouth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: zhuōzi, table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我的生日是三月五号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.
